mechanism: bounded revision- and lane-bound GDN checkpoint replacement with atomic native KV publication

modifications: Added an immutable checkpoint descriptor bound to revision, lane, KV offset and generation; mutable cache containers are private per branch while immutable tensor leaves may share references
Changed native KV/GDN companion handling from append history to exactly one checkpoint replacement per one-token accepted boundary
Kept the active checkpoint, unpublished private successor, and reader-retained retired generations in the existing atomic state-pointer owner
Required exact per-layer read terminal proof, idle nonpoisoned writer, and full one-token acceptance before atomic KV+GDN publication
Kept private cache roots with quarantined branches after pending or failed native work until terminal proof or one-way failed arena teardown
